purpose: Defines the generic document review criteria: delegated SSOT documents by priority, the check order for style, project rules and error handling, and the rules for choosing fix, create_issue or skip.
summary: Header stating the SoT is the review priorities spec and that severity comes from delegated principles
SSOT reference table of P1/P2/P3 delegated documents for generic document review
P1 sources: document style guide, project document rules via query-db-rules, error classification spec
Check order: style, project rules, error handling, contradictions, complexity
P2 contradiction check for term mismatches and duplicated descriptions
P3 unnecessary complexity check via the spec priorities spec
Fallback to the built-in style guide when no project rules exist
Judgment rules table for fix, create_issue and skip recommendations
tasks: Checking documents against the style guide and project writing rules
Reviewing how a document defines error handling
Deciding the recommendation (fix, create_issue, skip) for a document review finding
Editing or maintaining the generic review criteria
